newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt selling 73 pct of construction firm.
newsitem.headline: Egypt selling 73 pct of construction firm.

text.p: The Egyptian state Holding Company for Housing, Cinema and Tourism has sold to the private sector 62.6 percent of the shares in Development and Popular Houses, ending state control of the company, the agents for the partial privatisation said on Thursday.
Company employees will buy another 10 percent, or 350,000 of the 3.5 million shares in the construction firm.
Individuals applied to buy 451,055 shares in the firm, less than the initial allocation of 525,000 shares, agent Mohammed el-Sharnoubi of Banque Misr told Reuters.
But mutual funds and investment firms applied for 1.74 million shares against an allocation of 910,000 shares. They will get the whole amount they applied for, Sharnoubi said.

The holding company said shareholders would be eligible for a dividend of at least 2.73 pounds a share for the 1995/96 fiscal year which ended on June 30. The shares sold at a fixed price of 29.00 each.
The company increased net profits in 1995/96 by 3.6 percent to 12 million pounds from 11.59 million in the previous year.
